blocks.text: As I write this letter the weather continues to be severe across the nation. Now let us turn to a long overdue subject. California just got out of an epic drought, but seismologists say a new one is here, they call it “earthquake drought” because it’s been years since a major earthquake. Experts know this so-called drought will end with destructive results. California is in the midst of a 100-year earthquake drought and is long overdue for a powerful magnitude 7.0 or greater quake along the state’s three most-feared faults, a new study says. No one alive today in California has experienced a quake of such magnitude. A magnitude 7.9 quake like the San Francisco tremblor of 1906 would produce 45 times more shaking energy than the Northridge quake that struck in Los Angeles in 1994. Experts are certain of one thing, the quake drought must end at some point. They just don’t know when or where. Earthquakes are coming and the prophecy in this letter will reveal the significance of them. The increasing of quakes is a sign that this dispensation is ending, and a warning for men to repent everywhere. (Read Matt. 24:34) – And now let us continue with a quote from Neal Frisby’s library.

GLOBAL WARNING - All of these quakes reveal Jesus is now ready to leave the door to come for His saints soon! Part of this Script will be additional information concerning this subject. "June 28, 1992, the Arizona news said, Monster quake strikes California. It was felt in Arizona. They said beds wiggled, birds squawked and pots rattled. The Los Angeles News said it was the worst there in 40 years! It struck from Big Bear Lake and Yucca Valley felt in Los Angeles area. (Remember what the 17-year-old boy said about the area, and what I said years ago that it would affect Arizona, Scroll 190 – coma vision.) These are only foreshadows of what will start in those areas some day and Los Angeles and a huge section of California will slide into the sea. Tremendous catastrophic destruction and desolation beyond Sodom and Gomorrah! Concerning the great quakes that panicked California, the News said after these new quakes, over a thousand aftershocks took place as tourist fled city areas and etc.”

CENTURY QUAKES - Major California quakes in this century, arranged in order of magnitude on the Richter scale of ground motion, Here is a list: 8.3 (estimate) - San Francisco, 1906; 7.8 - Tehachapi Bakersfield, 1952; 7.7 - Offshore San Luis Obispo, 1927 (Brother Frisby used to live 30 miles from here.); 7.2 - North Coast, 1923; 7.1 - Bay Area, 1989; 7.1 - Offshore North Coast, 1991; 7.0 - Eureka, 1980; 6.9 - Eureka, 1992; 6.7 - Imperial Valley, 1940; 6.6 - Coyote, 1911; 6.6 to 6.0 (four quakes) - Mammoth Lakes, 1980; 6.5- Coalinga, 1983; 6.4 -Imperial Valley, 1979; 6.4 – Anza - Borrego Mountains, 1968; 6.4 - San Fernando, 1971; 6.3 – Long Beach, 1933; 6.3 -Santa Barbara, 1925; 6.2 - Morgan Hill, 1984,.6.1 (two quakes) – Monterey Bay, 1926; 6.1 - North Coast, 1991; 6.1 - Joshua Tree, 1992; 6.0 - Palm Springs, 1986. (Source: A.P.) - Let us include the 2 last quakes that struck California in 1992 - 7.4 Landers & 6.5 Big Bear Lake.

CONTINUING - We are going to list quakes that started at the beginning of this century over the world. Many of the greatest known quakes have taken place since 1906. In 1976 an earthquake in China killed almost 250,000 people they said. - A quake in Guatemala killed 27 thousand. In 1978, one in Iran killed 25,000 - A devastating quake hit Mexico - And the great quake that hit Alaska. In June 1992, a volcano erupted in Alaska also. We cannot list all of the devastating quakes that has occurred all over the world. Along with this we have seen severe weather conditions, famines and drastic sea changes.

The apocalyptic signs in the heavens are revealing the coming judgments upon the earth, and the soon return of Jesus for His saints. Hag. 2:6 said, He would shake, heaven and earth, the sea and the dry ground. We are living in this moment of history. Tremendous events are ahead, surprises and unexpected events for this nation! End quote. – Prophetic astronomy is given in Luke 21:25 and Ps. chap. 19. Recorded many times, prior to earthquakes, solar and lunar eclipses take place. Coming total solar eclipse: July 2, 2019 and partial lunar eclipse: July 16, 2019. – Jesus’ promises are true! He will be coming for the real believer. It is harvest time!

This month I am offering a book called “Prophecy Part 2” and DVD, “Prepare! Plus Healing Line.” We’re living in the most vital time in history. The last and most vital signs are truly here. Never has there been such a time that is so important that your help is needed. I know the Lord will bless and guide you with His wonderful wisdom. I will be remembering you in prayer.
